meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把一份 DAG 定义存成带名字的 JSON 文件（放在 .omo/dags 等库目录），之后按名字重新运行，不用每次粘贴定义；每次加载会轮换 key，默认生成一次新运行。
howto.when: 当你想保存一个 DAG、按名字运行已保存的图，或反复调度同一个多智能体图时触发。

say.text: 把当前这个 DAG 保存成 nightly-audit

say.note: 按名字加载并启动一次新运行（key 自动轮换）
指定后缀，复用同一次逻辑运行

howto.what_en: Claude stores a DAG definition as a named JSON file in the library dirs, then re-runs it by name instead of pasting the definition each time. Each load rotates the key, so calls start fresh runs by default.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or repeatedly schedule the same multi-agent graph.

say_en.text: Save the current DAG as nightly-audit

say_en.note: Loads by name and starts a fresh run (key rotates)
Explicit suffix reuses the same logical run
